task_goal: Produce evidence-backed structural and functional genome annotations without baking organism, provider, or workflow-system semantics into generic Creator code.
fixed_success_criteria: Every accepted annotation claim retains source evidence and provenance.
Conflicting claims are reconciled or explicitly unresolved.
All required remote handoffs and materialization edges pass independent integration checks.
Final qualification verifies artifact hashes, evidence gates, and required integration edges.

provider_preference.when: supported bacterial or archaeal input and policy-compatible authentication
provider_preference.fallback: select another declared provider without changing generic Creator code

cross_cutting_contracts.workspace_behavior: Inputs and outputs are referenced by locality, immutable identity, and content hash.
cross_cutting_contracts.remote_job_behavior: Submissions are idempotent; polling has bounded backoff; terminal interpretation, output discovery, verification, retention, and cleanup are explicit.
cross_cutting_contracts.secret_behavior: Authentication is injected by the human-controlled runtime and is never copied into shared state or artifacts.

task_inputs.stopping_rule: verified materialization or typed terminal fault

task_inputs.completion_policy: Only accepted claims count toward completion.

task_inputs.repair_policy: Route a bounded delta request to the owner and retest the affected edge plus required regressions.

task_inputs.yield: new unique host-accepted annotation or integration gates
task_inputs.stopping_rule: stop when configured marginal accepted yield or stagnation threshold is reached

task_inputs.deliverable: versioned annotation bundle with hashes and explicit unresolved cases
